item.text: I’m checking the official SSA snapshot and schedule first so the forecast is tied to the first-print table, then I’ll use only public values for the history and interval.

The SSA schedule page confirms the publication but does not expose a precise day in the text view; I’m checking the target metadata and SSA downloadable tables next, while keeping catalog estimates out of the forecast evidence.
I found only the active prompt for this specific target, so I’m not importing a prior forecast. The official current snapshot gives May 2026 as the latest first-print reference point.

item.text: The recent official sequence is Dec 2025 through May 2026: 7,126, 7,099, 7,081, 7,070, 7,050, 7,029 thousand disabled workers. I’m using the first-print Table 2 values and calculating the interval from those successive monthly changes.
